fields.Name: W1 -> S7.5 #2
fields.Description: Gate G1.9 (phase 1, dataset W1, criterion S7.5 #2): a string column bound as plain numeric select on W1-signal s42 stops the run with an error naming the column, 1 of 1, and 0 values are coerced to 0.0 (T16(a)). It fails when the as-of assembler's numeric encoding coerces a string to Number(x) || 0, so values are coerced and no error is raised.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Region bound numeric stops the run with non-numeric-in-numeric-column naming Region, 1 of 1; no model is created, so 0 values are coerced.
